quirks: styles.create only creates paragraph styles (there is no character-style primitive), so the banner is a named paragraph style verified in word/header1.xml
a paragraph style applied inside the header also lands on the body paragraph at the cursor; the restyle plan is re-applied after insert.closeHeader
select.collapse collapses to the selection start; caret.end is needed to append the fields at the end of the provenance line
file.properties has no custom-property field, so source_sha256 rides in keywords and is read back from docProps/core.xml
stamp_custom scales a stamp to at most 200 pt and centres it on `at`; the card sits at [480, 90] to stay inside the page
sign_list.all_valid is false for a just-signed file: sign_id_create produced a self-signed ID
